messages.subject: How to link multiple filters
parts: I have multiple filters in my user interface. I want to link them.i.e if i select a value in filter 1 , i should have options mapped to only filter 1 value in filter 2. For example if i have filters REGION, TYPE,STORE...if i select REGION= EAST, TYPE= A, i should see a reduced list of stores, not complete list.
